reviews.comment: Improved along the semester quickly. Responsive and use the feedback to improve teaching.

If you make it to all the quizzes (which are basically always 5/5) you can get a good grade, but she was not good at teaching this course at all. Too much MEEN 305 review. She could not answer many of the questions we asked in class and would just stare. Idk if she understood the material, but it was her first semester so maybe she will improve.

Very poor teaching. Handwriting is illegible and she doesn't post the filled-out notes after class, so if you miss something during the 15-20 seconds it's on-screen you will never see it again. Takes attendance quizzes. I learned most of the content of this class via YouTube. Easy to pass, very hard to get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes
